services.desc: Take a look at some of our favorite moments from the water. From dolphins to mantas, these clips show you exactly why we love what we do. Come see what a day out with Dolphin Discoveries is really like. This short commercial gives you a feel for the crew, the boats, and the Kona Coast before you ever step foot on the water. Calm and fully in the moment, this is exactly how a wild dolphin encounter should look, both above and below the surface. services.name: Snorkeling Basics
services.desc: Dive into the ocean under the stars as our expert crew leads you to the feeding grounds of Kona's manta rays. These gentle giants glide right beneath you. If you're choosing just one snorkel adventure on the Big Island, make it this unforgettable experience. Snorkel Kealakekua Bay, home of Captain Cook's Monument and one of the highest-rated snorkel spots on the Big Island of Hawaii. Tropical fish, Hawaiian sea turtles, and the occasional pod of dolphins, all in some of the clearest water on the Kona Coast. Snorkel two of Kona's best spots on one trip! services.name: Kona Private Boat Tour
services.desc: The Kona Coast is one of Hawaii's most spectacular stretches of ocean, offering everything from world-class snorkeling and dramatic lava sea cliffs to encounters with dolphins, sea turtles, and humpback whales (in season). With a private charter, you choose where you go, what you do, and how you spend your time, all with the expertise of our experienced crew guiding the way. No shared boats, no set schedules. Just your group, the open ocean, and an unforgettable day in paradise. Join us on our exclusive and private "Holo Holo" excursion. Holo Holo is Hawaiian for a cruise which brings pleasure.
